messages:
Irene: Quick follow-up from last night's PM — we're seeing a recurring ~2:00am latency spike on the gen-serve lanes. Need to assign remediation owners, create JIRA tickets, and spell out RACI so this doesn't slip.
Alex: Ack — I can own the rollout and verification plan if someone owns the root-cause fix.
MJ: +1. Can we split into a hotfix (safety patch) and a longer-term fix + monitoring changes?
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0319-17 — latency spike detected on gen-serve. Auto-notified oncall. See logs: https://logs.redwood/INC-2026-0319-17
Sam: I can take the root-cause work (investigate KV cache churn + batching regressions). Will need access to the perf traces and recent kernel builds.
Irene: Sam, please take RC. Alex will be accountable for rollout. MJ will be consulted for capacity/autoscaling policy. I'll be informed and do verification post-rollout.
Alex: Created tickets: REDW-5410 (hotfix: tighten batching thresholds) and REDW-5411 (postmortem remediation: KV caching + autoscaling playbook). Links: https://jira.redwood/browse/REDW-5410 and https://jira.redwood/browse/REDW-5411
Sam: I accept REDW-5410 and REDW-5411. ETA: hotfix prototype in 3 business days, full remediation in 10 business days. Weekly sync Tuesday standup ok for check-ins?
MJ: Tuesday standups work. For RACI here: Responsible=Sam (fix), Accountable=Alex (rollout), Consulted=MJ (infra/policy), Informed=Irene + SRE channel.
Irene: Please add clear acceptance criteria on REDW-5411: reproducible load test, no >10% tail latency regressions at 99th pct. Add smoke test to the canary.
Alex: Will add acceptance criteria to REDW-5411 now. Also adding a temporary alert adjustment to avoid noisy paging during the rollout.
Sam: Quick notes for the playbook I'm drafting:
```
- reproduce locally with seq_len=1024 workload
- capture KV cache hit/miss ratios over 1h window
- run canary at 10% traffic for 30m
- rollback if 99p latency > baseline + 15%
```
MJ: If we hit infra blockers, escalate to infra-oncall and tag REDW-Infra. Add the change to next sprint plan and mark as priority P1 for the dedicated cluster owners.
oncall-bot: Reminder: link tickets to the postmortem thread: https://redwood.slack/postmortems/1798887776. Auto-check at 24h.
Irene: I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and RACI and ping PM to prioritize the tickets in the next sprint. Sam — once you have the hotfix PR, ping me and Alex for verification steps. :thumbsup:
Sam: Will do. Creating a short remediation board in the team project and will drop links in REDW-5411. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
